fields.value: With the Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital precinct and university campuses nearby, Herston is full of people working long hours and studying hard. Precision Dental, a short trip away in Fortitude Valley, offers dental care that respects your time and helps you feel looked after.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: About Precision Dental

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: People who spend their days caring for others often put their own health last. We make it easy to change that, with prompt bookings, efficient appointments and a team who treat you with the same attention you give your own patients, students or family.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our coordinators can arrange a series of appointments ahead of time, so your care fits around rosters and exam periods. Learn more About Precision Dental and what guides our work.

sections.label: Why Herston Patients Choose Precision Dental

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Herston Patients Choose Precision Dental

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Honesty

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We give clear, evidence-informed explanations that health professionals and students appreciate, and we are always happy to answer detailed questions.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Comfort

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We aim to keep waiting to a minimum and let you set the pace of each appointment.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Quality

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Tools such as an intra-oral camera, digital X-rays and rotary endodontic instruments support accurate, efficient treatment.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Convenience

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: An 8am start on Fridays and 7pm finish on Tuesdays can work around many rosters and class timetables.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Safety

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our infection prevention and control protocols follow Dental Board of Australia guidelines and are reviewed as part of our accreditation.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Special Offers and Patient Benefits

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Families with eligible children can use the Child Dental Benefits Schedule, and we welcome Department of Veterans' Affairs card holders. Please contact us to confirm your entitlements before your visit.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: I work night shifts. Can I still book regular check-ups?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. Tell our team about your roster, and we will look for appointment times that suit you.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How do I know if I grind my teeth?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Common signs include morning jaw aches, headaches, worn or chipped teeth and tooth sensitivity. We can check for signs at your visit.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Will a night splint stop me grinding?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A splint may not stop the habit, but it helps protect your teeth and reduce strain on your jaw.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can students get a check-up and clean?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Absolutely. Many extras policies cover check-ups and cleans, and we process claims on the spot through HICAPS.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: I am exhausted and nervous about treatment. Can you help?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. We can keep appointments shorter, take breaks and offer happy gas to help you relax.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What should I do if my face is swollen?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Call us promptly for an urgent appointment. If swelling affects your breathing or swallowing, call 000 or go to your nearest hospital emergency department.
